about: item.value names the enclosing loop's item (chapter 4 § 4.2.2). The for sections outlines each section of the input sections. Invalid: it iterates item.value.points, but it runs inside no loop. Valid: input.sections.value.
sentences: Loop 'sections' iterates item.value.points, but it runs inside no loop; item.value names the enclosing loop's item.
